approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content, using existing open-source and standard-library paths where possible.
notes: A synthetic Outlook MSG reproduction showed one unnamed PDF attachment as 'unnamed attachment' in the parser summary and 'attachment-1.pdf' in the selection/import path.
Reuse the existing safe_attachment_name helper in the MSG parser and advance the parser cache version; add no dependency or new naming system.
Attachments remain inert and require explicit reviewer selection before import or analysis.
Parser inventory and selected import now both expose attachment-1.pdf for the same unnamed MSG PDF; supplied names retain the shared helper behavior.
642 Python, 24 UI and 11 deployment-boundary tests passed offline with 105 requirements, 15 schemas and a 364-file bundle manifest; no customer email, external request or paid call was used.
title: Unify unnamed MSG attachment names
objective: Make the parser summary and reviewer selection/import path use the same deterministic MIME-derived name for unnamed Outlook MSG attachments.
